# Rollback for 1.32

`OutAndBack-129.apk` is version 1.31 (before the new multiplayer games) with a higher version number (1.31.1, code 129), so it installs over 1.32.

To roll everyone back: copy `rollback.json` over `dist/latest.json` (and `OutAndBack-129.apk` over `dist/OutAndBack.apk`). Phones see the update within 12 hours.
To roll back only your own phone: download `OutAndBack-129.apk` and install it.
